description: This file declares factory classes and creation functions for various channel coding components such as CRC calculators, LDPC encoders/decoders, polar encoders/decoders, and segmenters within the 'ocudu' namespace. It serves as a central interface for creating instances of these components.

classes.name: crc_calculator_factory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating CRC calculator instances.

classes.name: ldpc_decoder_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating LDPC decoder instances with configuration options.

classes.name: ldpc_encoder_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating LDPC encoder instances.

classes.name: ldpc_rate_dematcher_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating LDPC rate dematcher instances.

classes.name: ldpc_rate_matcher_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating LDPC rate matcher instances.

classes.name: ldpc_segmenter_rx_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating LDPC segmenter receiver instances.

classes.name: ldpc_segmenter_tx_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating LDPC segmenter transmitter instances.

classes.name: polar_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating polar coding components such as encoder, decoder, allocator, deallocator, and interleaver.

classes.name: short_block_detector_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating short block detector instances.

methods.name: create_crc_calculator_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a CRC calculator factory based on the specified type.

methods.name: create_ldpc_decoder_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an LDPC decoder factory with specified type and configuration.

methods.name: create_ldpc_encoder_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an LDPC encoder factory based on the specified type.

methods.name: create_ldpc_rate_dematcher_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an LDPC rate dematcher factory based on the specified type.

methods.name: create_ldpc_rate_matcher_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an LDPC rate matcher factory.

methods.name: create_ldpc_segmenter_rx_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an LDPC segmenter receiver factory.

methods.name: create_ldpc_segmenter_tx_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an LDPC segmenter transmitter factory, given a CRC factory.

methods.name: create_polar_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a polar factory for generating polar coding components.

methods.name: create_short_block_detector_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a short block detector factory.
